hge: Original fixed PET3mm/day parameters calibrated before2026-07-01, existing conservative unit-sum routing kernels, rating curve, residual correction tau6h. No parameter search.
origins: Hourly2026-07-01T00:00:00-03:00 through2026-09-21T00:00:00-03:00 exclusive; each target must also precede the latter cutoff.
anchor: Require exact finite paired raw Muçum H/Q at origin minus15minutes; no carried truth or imputed anchor. This simulates the frozen15h source latency, not historical publication proof.
rain: Past HGE state uses observed/completed rainfall only through origin minus1hour. routing: For each kernel, negative relative lead uses historical flow strictly before origin; nonnegative lead uses frozen model inference. Generate forecasts for every origin with admissible inputs, even if future upstream observations are absent. Missing future upstream truth must not select the sample.
initial_correction: Reconstruct past upstream flow at origin minus1hour and origin using historical lagged flows only; combine corresponding HGE local runoff. Interpolate to the exact15min anchor, then apply common observedQ residual and common rating offset to both families.
evaluation: Same target pairs for both families, exact finite raw Muçum targets. Report exclusions, MAE,bias,P90,P98,maximum and fraction within0.50m separately per nominal horizon and observed>=7m. Historical nominal horizons are not real ledger issuance horizons. Previously inspected periods remain development, not independent prospective evidence.
anomalies: Preserve the identified July downstream level spike and all prior input values; no new masks or changes to model training.
